ar: قُلْ أَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِۙ ۝۱ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَۙ ۝۲ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَۙ ۝۳ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِي الْعُقَدِۙ ۝۴ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ۝۵ ـ سَبْعًا
tr: Qul a`ūdhu bi Rabbi ‘l-Falaq (1) Min sharri mā Khalaq (2) Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab (3) Wa min sharri ‘n-naffathāti fi ‘l-`uqad (4) Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad (5)
en: In the name of Allah, The Profoundly Merciful, The Continually Merciful

Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of Daybreak (1) From the mischief of what He created (2) And from the mischief of darkness when it sets in (3) And from the mischief of magic's dischargers (4) And from the mischief of the envious when they envy (5) . [7 times]
